facts.text: Melanie shared a photo of a pottery bowl with a colorful design, expressing pride in her work.

evidence.quote: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience. Thoughts? [image: a photo of a bowl with a colorful design on it]

facts.text: Melanie explained that the colorful patterns and design on her pottery bowl were inspired by her desire to create something that catches the eye and makes people smile.

evidence.quote: I'm obsessed with those, so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that painting helps her express her feelings and be creative, with each stroke representing a part of herself.

evidence.quote: Plus, painting helps me express my feelings and be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.

facts.text: Caroline expressed admiration for Melanie's pottery, noting the effort and passion she put into her work.

evidence.quote: That's amazing! You put so much effort and passion into it.
